name: Kichiku Megane
source:
Katsuya is an incompetent white-collar worker, who is about to get fired. One day, a man suddenly appears in front of him, and gives him a pair of glasses. "If you wear these glasses, your life will change 180 degrees." Yes, it's true! While he wears them, he becomes a competent worker. But, he doesn't know these glasses also make him wild and violent....
[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090403071834/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_52/products_id/1007289]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
克哉是一名能力低下、即将遭到解雇的上班族。某天，一名男子突然出现在他面前，交给他一副眼镜。“戴上这副眼镜，你的人生将发生180度大转变。”这话果然是真的！戴上眼镜后，他会变成一名精明能干的职员。但克哉并不知道，这副眼镜也会令他变得狂野而暴力……
[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090403071834/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_52/products_id/1007289]Eroge Shop[/url]]
